An https image URL is extracted into metadata.images when extract_metadata is true

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><img src=\"https://example.com/photo.jpg\" alt=\"A photo\"></p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
